Samir (Support): FYI: customer using python sdk v0.9.1 sees intermittent 401 then 429s after we deployed new openapi spec yesterday. Escalating.
Devon (DevEx): Can you paste the error and minimal repro? 401 stack + client version please.
Samir (Support): Error from logs:
```
requests.exceptions.HTTPError: 401 Client Error: Unauthorized for url: https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
  File "/srv/app/main.py", line 42, in handle
    resp = client.generate(prompt)
```
Also found this in the deploy job: `openapi-regen@main` updated header casing and removed `x-api-key` example. deploy-bot attached: failed tests on clients/python-ci #712 :x
Devon (DevEx): likely cause: cross-sdk regen changed security scheme id from `ApiKeyAuth` to `apiKey`. Some generators map that differently -> auth header became optional. Does pip freeze show any client pinned? can you ask customer to run `pip show redwood-sdk` and `python -c "import redwood;print(redwood.__version__)"`?
Samir (Support): customer says `redwood-sdk 0.9.1` and their code sets env REDWOOD_API_KEY. Repro steps I ran locally:
1) checkout repo @ release/0.9.1
2) `pip install -e ./clients/python`
3) run snippet:
```python
from redwood import Redwood
c=Redwood()
c.generate("hello")
```
gets 401
Devon (DevEx): don't retry on 401; but root is mismatch between installed client and openapi spec used by hosted API. We rolled spec change but didn't regenerate pinned clients in CI. Short-term: customer can set header explicitly:
```python
from redwood import Redwood
c=Redwood(api_key="sk-...")
```
Long-term: we need to regenerate clients, bump versions, and update CI to fail on client-api mismatch.
Maya (DevRel): tagging for release notes and changelog. @Devon can you open a regen PR and include changelog entry "fix: restore ApiKey security id mapping, ensure Authorization header usage" :memo:
Devon (DevEx): opening PR now -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/clients/pull/345 :eyes:
ci-bot: client-python-ci #712 failed -> diff in generated clients vs checked-in: `clients/python/generated/*` changed
deploy-bot: deploy job `openapi-regen@main` -> commit 7f9c2ab changed securitySchemes in openapi.yaml
Ryan (Eng-ML): also see increased 429s because retry logic in older client aggressively retried 401->429. We should add a short-circuit: no retry if 401 or 403. Filing internal ticket.
Samir (Support): customer confirmed workaround with explicit api_key works. Marking as escalated->resolved pending regen PR.
Devon (DevEx): action items: 1) regen all SDKs and bump patch 2) update CI to run `openapi diff` precommit 3) add test that 401 isn't retried 4) post changelog. I'll assign and link tickets.
Maya (DevRel): I'll draft changelog blurb and ping SALES for affected accounts.
Samir (Support): thanks everyone :thumbsup:
